DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Pillar of Frost is active (if the Deathknight has the talent) or they do not use the talent.
  • The Deathknight is specced into Obliteration.
  • The Deathknight is specced into Breath of Sindragosa and the ability is currently active.
  • The Deathknight is not specced into either Obliteration or Breath of Sindragosa.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They are fighting at least 3 enemies while Dark Transformation is active or their Death and Decay area effect is active.
  • Their Gargoyle pet is active with ≤22 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • Using a single-target build or fighting remaining adds alongside one of these cooldowns: Dark Transformation active, Army Ghouls with ≤18s remaining, Abomination pet with <18s remaining, or Gargoyle unavailable for over 10 seconds.
  • In builds without Gargoyle, when Dark Transformation is active regardless of other talents.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They are in Metamorphosis, as this amplifies their primary burst damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds to avoid holding the cooldown unused.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their major offensive cooldowns (Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune) are active or being activated.
  • They have pooled astral power for Starsurge spam during their eclipse phase.
  • They’re using Convoke the Spirits in their rotation (Night Fae covenant).
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid is under the effect of the Berserk buff.
  • The Feral Druid has not selected the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • The Evoker has Dragonrage active and their Shattering Star is on cooldown.
  • The Evoker has Dragonrage active and the target is affected by Shattering Star
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Their Trueshot buff has more than 12 seconds remaining, allowing maximum synergy with their primary damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 13 seconds, ensuring Power Infusion isn’t wasted before the fight concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • The Hunter’s Coordinated Assault is currently active.
  • Spearhead is on cooldown and the Hunter does not have the Coordinated Assault talent.
  • The Hunter has neither the Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talents selected.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They do not have Spymaster's Web equipped and their previous spell was Arcane Surge (post-cast timing).
  • They have Spymaster's Web equipped and their previous spell was Evocation (post-cast timing).
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Combustion is about to come off cooldown (within their pre-cast preparation window) to align with their burst phase.
  • Combustion is already active with more than 7 seconds remaining to maximize cooldown overlap.
  • The encounter will end in less than 20 seconds to ensure full benefit before combat finishes.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • They do not already have Power Infusion active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is not active.
  • Xuen the White Tiger is active, Bloodlust is active, and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • The Paladin has activated Avenging Wrath to enhance their damage output.
  • The Paladin is under the effect of Crusade to amplify their burst window.
  • The target is afflicted by the Execution Sentence debuff, signaling a critical damage phase.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • They have Deathmark actively damaging the target, as this maximizes burst damage synergy during their key cooldown window.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has an active Shadow Dance buff to amplify their burst damage during this high-impact window.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • The Shaman is currently under the effect of Ascendance to amplify its damage window.
  • The remaining cooldown of Ascendance exceeds 30 seconds, ensuring alignment with future burst phases.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They activate Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds during combat.
  • The encounter is within the final 20 seconds of a 2-minute window (e.g., timed burst phases or fight duration alignment).
  • Their core cooldowns (e.g., Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds) are available and not on cooldown for at least 120 seconds.
  • They lack talents like Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds, ensuring Power Infusion is used as a general cooldown boost.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • They activate major DPS cooldowns (including Summon Darkglare and Soul Rot) to amplify their burst window.
  • Their rotation aligns with pre-planned damage phases where stacking cooldowns maximizes pandemic uptime for critical abilities.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Imps are about to despawn within the next two global cooldowns plus Summon Demonic Tyrant's cast time.
  • They just cast Hand of Gul'dan or Ruination to summon or empower demons.
  • Imp despawn is imminent within the next global cooldown plus Summon Demonic Tyrant's cast time or they have fewer than 2 Soul Shards remaining.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Summon Infernal is currently active during its burst window.
  • They are not using the Summon Infernal talent in their build.
  • The fight will end before their next Summon Infernal cooldown, but after Power Infusion’s full duration can be utilized.
  • The remaining encounter time is less than 15 seconds beyond when their next Summon Infernal would become available.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • The Fury Warrior is in the execute phase and has Avatar active.
  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining in a fight lasting longer than 135 seconds.
  • The encounter is within the final 25 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
